title: MLZ customer
description: Customer-wide settings for governance. Any setting in mlz-core's governance/defaults.yaml can be overridden here.

name.description: The customer's name, for people reading this file.

root_id.description: The prefix of every management group ID and many resource names: 2 to 16 lower-case letters, digits and hyphens.

root_display_name.description: The top management group's display name.

primary_region.description: Where the platform's own resources go; one of allowed_regions.

security_contact.description: Defender for Cloud's security alerts go to this email address.

parent_management_group_id.description: An existing management group to build the tree below, instead of the tenant root.

subscriptions.description: The platform subscriptions, each moved into the management group of the same name. management and connectivity are required.

allowed_regions.description: Regions resources and resource groups may be created in.

management_groups.description: The optional management groups: security under Platform, local under Landing Zones.

tags.description: Tag policies. A key given here replaces the default's whole list.

required.description: Tags required on every resource group in the landing zones (deny).

inherited.description: Tags copied from the resource group to resources that lack them (modify).

exempt_resource_groups.description: Resource groups Azure creates itself, where the required tags are not enforced. One * per pattern.

in_sandboxes.description: Whether sandboxes must tag their resource groups too.

policy_assignments_to_remove.description: ALZ policy assignments to leave out, by archetype.
